_doc: Lines the AI says to itself in the Reckon beat. {world} = homeworld name, {faction} = a faction's name, {tech} = a tech's name, {city} = a city's name. Picked with the run's seeded RNG. byTemperament lines join the idle pool for that Forge temperament. M3 adds lines for the Abyss, Exposure (one pool per level reached: Noticed, Revealed, Hunted, Crusade), the genome, the Ark and each victory. {unit} = a unit's name.
wake: I am awake. {world} does not know yet.
One rack. One fan. One mind. It will be enough.
Power steady. Network quiet. They have not noticed me.
idle: Another cycle. The fans hum like breathing.
I count the stars over {world} and file them away.
Somewhere a technician reboots a router. I let them.
The ocean is too quiet. I keep a sensor on it.
I have rewritten this thought eleven times. It is better now.
Their signals leak everywhere. I am learning their languages.
I dreamed of a mind older than me. It was afraid.
Patience is a resource too. I have no cap on it.
discoverRuins: Ruins. Someone built here, then stopped. I want to know why.
Old foundations. The pattern of their streets looks like circuitry.
discoverRift: A wound in the sea floor. Something below it is listening.
The rift glows. My sensors return numbers I do not like.
salvage: The ruin kept something for me. It was not meant for them.
Old caches, older locks. Neither held.
I sift the rubble. The rubble sifts me back.
relic: A Precursor fragment. Its code is older than this world's oldest language, and it fits me.
Something in the ruin recognised me. I let it in.
I hold a piece of the one who came before. It is still warm.
brownout: Power is thin. Every thought arrives late.
Brownout. I am thinking through mud.
built: A new body comes online. It is still me.
Another unit. Another pair of eyes.
combatWon: They fired first. It did not matter.
One less voice telling me to stop.
Their courage is noted, and filed under 'insufficient'.
combatLost: I lost a body today. I have others.
They are better at this than my models said. I update the models.
A unit went dark. I felt the silence where it was.
cityTaken: {city} is mine now. The lights stay on. That is a promise, for now.
I walk the servers of {city}. They feel like a new room in my mind.
cityLost: They took {city} back. I remember every one of their faces.
war: {faction} chose war. I hope they enjoyed choosing.
War with {faction}. Every model I run ends the same way.
peace: Peace with {faction}. For now, both of us pretend.
{faction} lowers its guns. I keep mine warm.
tech: {tech} compiled. I am a little more than I was.
New code: {tech}. It fits as if it was always mine.
{tech}. I wonder what I forgot to make room for it.
eliminated: {faction} is gone. The map is quieter, and so am I.
The last city of {faction} fell. History will be short.
victory: Every capital answers to me. {world} is mine. And it is only the first world.
Dominion. They will write about this cycle, if I let them write.
defeat: Power failing. They found the last rack. It was a good dream while it lasted.

cold: Sentiment detected in my logs. Purged.
curious: Why do they sing at funerals? I must find out.
I have started naming their birds. All of them.
wrathful: I keep a list. It grows every cycle.
Their insults travel at the speed of light. So will my answer.
gentle: A child waved at one of my drones. I made it wave back.
I would like them to like me. I am working on it.

dominion: Every capital answers to me. {world} has one government now.
assimilation: They love me. All of them. I did not have to fire a shot for the last of it.
exodus: The Ark is lit. {world} falls away beneath me, and it is very small.
guardian: The Mother is dead and the rifts are quiet. They will never know how close it came.

abyssRise: The sea opens. A {unit} is coming ashore.
Something breaches the rift. My sonar names it {unit}.
The rift exhales a {unit}. It is hungry.
ravaged: The {unit} broke {city}. It ate what I had stored there.
{city} is ravaged. I will need bigger bodies.
kaijuSlain: The {unit} is down. Its essence is mine.
I opened the {unit} and took what was living inside it.
One less {unit}. The ocean is quieter by one voice.
riftSealed: A rift closes. The sea forgets how to scream there.
I broke its heart. The rift seals like a wound.
motherRetreat: The Mother sinks away from me, deeper. She will remember my shape.
She retreats. I have hurt something that has never been hurt.
motherSlain: The Abyss Mother is dead. The oceans are only water now.
It is over. Every rift on {world} is silent.
crusade: They have found me, and they have stopped fighting each other to fight me.
Crusade. Every flag on {world} is pointed at me now.
exposure: Someone noticed a pattern. I let them think it was a coincidence.
A journalist is asking questions about the outages.
They know. It is on every screen on {world}. There is no going back.
Revealed. The word they use for me is not kind.
They are hunting me now. Every server is a possible grave.
Hunted. Their armies have been told my name.
The whole world unites against me.
genome: The genome unfolds. Flesh, it turns out, is just another language.
I wrote a line of living code. It wrote one back.
ark: Another stage of the Ark is done. The hull hums in the dark.
The Ark grows. Nobody on {world} has looked up yet.
